In this notebook, I will make plots for Main Figure 4

# Setup

```{r setup}
library(Seurat)
library(scales)
library(tidyverse)
library(tidytext)

thisseed <- 231103

colFGID <- "#1E88E5"
coliCD <- "#55D276"
colcCD <- "#FFC107"
colUC <- "#D81B60"
diagSubColVec <- c("FGID"=colFGID, "iCD" = coliCD, "cCD"=colcCD, "UC"=colUC)

diagSub.comp <- list(c("FGID", "cCD"), c("iCD", "cCD"), c("cCD", "UC"), c("FGID", "UC"))

colNM <- "#6b6a6a"
colNOA <- "#bfbfbf"
colFR <- "#11d6cc"
colPR <- "#ff8c00"
colNR <- "#ff1e00"
atnfColVec <- c("NM"=colNM, "NOA"=colNOA,"FR"=colFR,"PR"=colPR,"NR"=colNR)

colPre <-  colcCD
colPost <- "#ee82ee"

colCelltypes <- RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(n = 7, "Set1")[c(1:5,7)]
names(colCelltypes) <- c("ColEpi", "Stroma", "Myeloid", "Plasma", "BCell", "TNKILC")

`%notin%` <- Negate(`%in%`)

source("../functions/ComparisonPlottingFxns.R")
```

## Obs

```{r}
obs <- readRDS("out/annotations/scvi/251017__predictCOL_CB_allcells_obs.rds")
obs
```

## TNF

```{r}
tnfjak.paths <- list.files("out/decoupler/progeny/mlm_tnfjak", full.names = T)
tnfjak.paths

tnfjak.paths <- tnfjak.paths[str_detect(tnfjak.paths, "estimate.csv")]
tnfjak.paths
```


```{r}
tnfjak.list <- lapply(tnfjak.paths, function(thispath) read_csv(thispath, show_col_types = F))

tnfjak.df <- plyr::ldply(tnfjak.list)

tnf.df <- tnfjak.df %>% 
  rename(TNF = TNFa) %>% 
  select(barcode, TNF) %>% 
  rename(TNF = TNF)

tnf.df
```

```{r}
obs.dc <- tnf.df %>% 
    left_join(obs %>% rownames_to_column("barcode"), ., by = "barcode")

obs.dc %>% select(colnames(tnf.df))
```

# TNF

```{r, fig.width=3.5, fig.height=4}
PlotBoxplotsFeatures(
  df = obs.dc %>% filter(timepoint == "T0"),
  features = c("TNF"),
  exportObservationDF = T
) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(y = featureVal, x = celltype)) + 
  geom_violin(scale = "width", aes(fill = celltype)) + 
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.4) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = colCelltypes) +
  labs(
    y = "TNF Pathway Score"
  ) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 2)) +
  theme_light() +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "top",
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black", linewidth = 1.5),
    strip.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 16, face = "bold")
  ) 
```

```{r, fig.width=4.5, fig.height=4}
PlotBoxplotsFeatures(
  obs.dc %>% 
    filter(diagSub != "UC") %>% 
    filter(timepoint != "R2") %>% 
    filter(!(diagSub == "iCD" & timepoint != "T0")) %>% 
    filter(!(diagSub == "UC" & antitnf_response == "NOA")) %>% 
    filter(!(diagSub == "cCD" & antitnf_response == "NM")) %>% 
    filter(!(diagSub == "cCD" & antitnf_response == "NOA")),
  features = "TNF",
  relative.to = "celltype",
  filterCol = "celltype",
  filterVal = c("Myeloid", "TNKILC"),
  xVar = "diagSub",
  fillVar = "timepoint",
  ncol = 10,
  facetType = "grid",
  facet_scales = "free_y",
  swap_facets = F,
  facet_dir = "v",
  minDenomFreq = 10,
  plotTitle = NULL,
  exportSampleDF = T
)  %>% 
  mutate(timepoints = n_distinct(timepoint)) %>% 
  ungroup %>% 
  filter(!(timepoint == "R" & diagSub %notin% c("cCD", "UC"))) %>%
  mutate(timegroup = ifelse(diagSub %in% c("cCD", "UC"), as.character(timepoint), as.character(diagSub))) %>% 
  mutate(timegroup = ifelse(timegroup == "T0", "PreTx\ncCD", timegroup)) %>% 
  mutate(timegroup = ifelse(timegroup == "R", "PostTx\ncCD", timegroup)) %>% 
  mutate(timegroup = fct_relevel(timegroup, c("FGID", "iCD", "PreTx\ncCD", "PostTx\ncCD"))) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = ifelse(timepoint == "T0", "PreTx", "PostTx")) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = fct_relevel(timepoint, c("PreTx", "PostTx"))) %>% 
  group_by(timegroup, celltype, featureVar, .drop = FALSE) %>% 
  mutate(mean = mean(meanVal, na.rm = T)) %>% 
  mutate(se = sd(meanVal, na.rm = T)/sqrt(n())) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  ggplot(., aes(x = timegroup, y = meanVal)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "summary", fun = "mean",  color = "black", fill = "gray90") +
  geom_line(aes(group = participant_id), color = "black", lwd = 0.75, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = timegroup), stroke = 2, shape = 21,
             position = position_jitter(width = 0.0, seed = thisseed), alpha = 0.75, size = 4) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - se, ymax = mean + se), color = "black", width=0.3, linewidth=1, alpha = 0.4) +
  facet_grid(~celltype, scales = "free") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("FGID" = colFGID, "iCD" = coliCD, "PreTx\ncCD" = colcCD, "PostTx\ncCD" = colPost)) +
  guides(color = "none") +
  stat_compare_means(
    comparisons = list(
    c("PreTx\ncCD", "PostTx\ncCD"),
    c("iCD", "PreTx\ncCD"),
    c("FGID", "PreTx\ncCD")
    ),
    label = "p.format", method = "wilcox.test", vjust = 1.4, size = 6, label.y = c(16, 18.5,21), tip.length = 0.05, bracket.size = 1) +
  labs(
    y = "Mean TNF Pathway Score",
    color = NULL,
    fill = NULL,
    title = NULL,
    shape = NULL,
    subtitle = NULL) +
  theme_light() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.box = "vertical",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", color = "black"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "black", linewidth = 1),
    panel.spacing.x = unit(0.1, "cm")
  )
```

# cCD Pre vs. Post DE

```{r}
de.ccdprepost.cellatnftypes.df <- read_csv("out/deseq2/DE__cCDPostvsPre_atnfcelltypes.csv") %>% 
  mutate(annotation = fct_relevel(annotation, names(colCelltypes)))

de.ccdprepost.cellatnftypes.df
```

```{r, fig.width=14, fig.height=8}
de.ccdprepost.cellpreposttypes.range <- de.ccdprepost.cellatnftypes.df$log2FoldChange %>% range %>% abs %>% max %>% ceiling
de.ccdprepost.cellpreposttypes.range <- c(-de.ccdprepost.cellpreposttypes.range, de.ccdprepost.cellpreposttypes.range)

ggplot(de.ccdprepost.cellatnftypes.df %>% 
         mutate(labelname = ifelse((padj <= 0.001), gene, NA)) %>% 
         mutate(prepost = ifelse(sign(stat) == 1, "PostTx", "PreTx")) %>% 
         mutate(pointfill = ifelse(padj <= 0.05, prepost, "Not DE")) %>% 
         mutate(prepost = fct_relevel(prepost, c("PreTx", "PostTx"))), 
       aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = -log10(padj), label = labelname)) + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), lty = 2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = -1, lty = 2) + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, lty = 2) +  
  geom_point(shape = 21, size = 3, color = "black", aes(fill = pointfill)) +
  geom_label_repel(aes(color = pointfill, size = -log10(padj)), seed = thisseed,
                   fontface = "bold", max.overlaps = 75, alpha=0.75, show.legend = F, label.padding = 0.1, label.size = 2) +
  geom_label_repel(aes(size = -log10(padj)), color = "black", seed = thisseed,
                   fontface = "bold", max.overlaps = 75, alpha=0.75, show.legend = F, label.padding = 0.1, label.size = 0) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("PreTx" = colPre, "PostTx" = colPost), limits = c("PreTx", "PostTx")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("PreTx" = colPre, "PostTx" = colPost, "Not DE" = "gray50"), limits = c("PreTx", "Not DE", "PostTx"), 
                    labels = c("PreTx" = "Enriched in Pre-treatment cCD", 
                               "Not DE" = "Not DE", 
                               "PostTx" = "Enriched in Post-treatment cCD")) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(2,4)) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = de.ccdprepost.cellpreposttypes.range) +
  facet_wrap(~annotation, scales = "fixed", nrow = 1) +
  labs(
    color = NULL,
    fill = NULL,
    size = "Percent Expression",
    x = "Average Log2 FC",
    y = "-Log10 P Value (Adjusted)",
    title = NULL
  ) +
  theme_light() +
  theme(
    legend.text = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.box = "vertical",
    strip.text = element_text(size = 30, face = "bold", color="black"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color="black"), 
    axis.text = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold")
  ) + 
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1, override.aes = list(size = 8)))
```

# GSEA

```{r}
gsea.ccdprepost.atnfcelltypes.df <- read_csv("out/gsea/GSEA__cCDPostvsPre_atnfcelltypes.csv") %>% 
  mutate(annotation = fct_relevel(annotation, names(colCelltypes)))

gsea.ccdprepost.atnfcelltypes.df
```

```{r, fig.width=8.75, fig.height=8}
range.x.max <- min(gsea.ccdprepost.atnfcelltypes.df %>% filter(NES <0) %>% pull(NES)) %>% abs
range.fill.max <- -log10(gsea.ccdprepost.atnfcelltypes.df %>% filter(NES<0) %>% pull(padj) %>% min) %>% ceiling

gsea.ccdprepost.atnfcelltypes.df %>% 
  as_tibble %>% 
  filter(padj <= 0.05) %>% 
  filter(NES < 0) %>% 
  mutate(NES = -NES) %>% 
  group_by(annotation) %>% 
  slice_min(order_by = padj, n = 10) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = NES, n = 10) %>%
  mutate(pathway = str_wrap(pathway, width = 25)) %>%
  arrange(-NES) %>% 
  ungroup %>% 
  ggplot(aes(y = reorder_within(pathway, NES, annotation), x = NES)) +
  geom_col(aes(fill=-log10(padj)), col = "black", lwd = 1.25) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "gray80", high = colPre, limits = c(1,range.fill.max), breaks = seq(1,range.fill.max,1)) +
  facet_wrap(~annotation, scales = "free_y", ncol=2) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(1,2.5)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(1,2.5, 0.5)) +
  scale_y_reordered() +
  labs(
    y=NULL, 
    fill = "Adjusted Pvalue (-Log10)",
    x="Normalized Enrichment Score",
    title="Reactome Pathways Enriched in Pre-Treatment cCD"
  ) +
  theme_classic() + 
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", vjust = 0.75),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold")
  )
```

# Cell Frequency

```{r, fig.width=32, fig.height=6}
PlotBoxplotsProp(
  obs %>% 
    mutate(atnf = paste(diagSub, antitnf, sep = ".")) %>%
    mutate(ibd.atnf = case_when(
      diagSub == "FGID" ~ "FGID",
      diagSub == "iCD" ~ "iCD",
      diagSub == "cCD" & timepoint != "T0" & antitnf_response %in% c("FR", "PR", "NR") ~ "Post.cCD",
      diagSub == "cCD" & timepoint != "T0" & antitnf_response %notin% c("FR", "PR", "NR") ~ "Other.cCD",
      diagSub == "cCD" & timepoint == "T0" ~ "Pre.cCD",
      diagSub == "UC" ~ "UC",
    )) %>%
    mutate(ibd.atnf = fct_relevel(ibd.atnf, c("FGID", "iCD", "Other.cCD", "Pre.cCD", "Post.cCD", "UC"))) %>%
    filter(diagSub != "UC") %>% 
    filter(!(diagSub == "iCD" & timepoint == "R")) %>% 
    filter(ibd.atnf != "Other.cCD" & timepoint != "R2") %>% 
    filter(!(diagSub == "cCD" & antitnf_response %notin% c("FR", "PR", "NR"))) %>% 
    droplevels,
  ann.col = "cellstate",
  filterCol = "cellstate",
  filterVal = c("Th1", "TFPI2Hi Fibro.", "Inflm. Mac", "Treg", "XCL+ NK", "MNP", "Th17"),
  relative.to = "celltype",
  xVar = "ibd.atnf",
  fillVar = "antitnf_response",
  fillVector = ibdAtnfColVec,
  testComp = ibdonlyAtnf.comp,
  minDenomFreq = 10,
  exportDF = T
) %>% 
  mutate(antitnf_response = fct_relevel(antitnf_response, c("FR", "PR"))) %>% 
  mutate(participant_id = str_split(biopsy, "_", simplify=T)[,1]) %>%
  mutate(cellstate = fct_relevel(cellstate, c("Th1", "TFPI2Hi Fibro.", "Inflm. Mac", "Treg", "XCL+ NK", "MNP", "Th17"))) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = ibd.atnf, y = prop)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, fill = NA) +
  geom_line(lwd = 1, aes(group=participant_id, color = antitnf_response)) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = ibd.atnf), size = 4,
             shape = 21, alpha = 0.75, position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.75, seed = thisseed)) +
  facet_wrap(~cellstate, scales = "free_y", nrow = 1) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 7)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(colFGID, coliCD, colPre, colPost)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = atnfColVec, breaks = c("FR", "PR")) +
  stat_compare_means(comparisons = list(c("Pre.cCD", "Post.cCD")), label = "p.format",
                     vjust = 2, size = 8, tip.length=0.05, bracket.size = 1.2) + 
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("FGID", "iCD", "PreTx\ncCD", "PostTx\ncCD")) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent) +
  guides(fill = "none", color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(lwd = 5))) +
  labs(
    y = "Cell State %\n(Relative to Cell Type)", 
    fill = NULL,
    color = "Anti-TNF\nResponse"
    ) +
  theme_light() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
    legend.key.height = unit(1,"cm"),
    legend.key.width = unit(1,"cm"),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold", hjust = 0),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
    panel.spacing.x = unit(0.5,"cm"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 28, face = "bold", color = "black"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "black", linewidth = 1),
  ) + guides(size = guide_legend(nrow = 1))
```

```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=8}
plot.a <- PlotBoxplotsFeatures(
  seuobj@meta.data %>% 
    filter(diagSub %in% c("cCD") & antitnf_response %in% c("FR", "PR") & timepoint != "R2"),
  seurat = "seuobj",
  features = c("TNF", "IFNG", "IL17A"),
  relative.to = "cellsubtype",
  filterCol = "cellsubtype",
  filterVal = c("Thelper"),
  xVar = "antitnf_response",
  fillVar = "timepoint",
  ncol = 10,
  facetType = "grid",
  facet_scales = "free_y",
  swap_facets = F,
  facet_dir = "v",
  minDenomFreq = 10,
  plotTitle = NULL,
  exportSampleDF = T
)  %>%
  group_by(antitnf_response, timepoint, tgroup, featureVar, .drop = FALSE) %>% 
  mutate(mean = mean(meanVal, na.rm = T)) %>% 
  mutate(se = sd(meanVal, na.rm = T)/sqrt(n())) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = ifelse(timepoint == "T0", "cCD PreTx", "cCD PostTx")) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = fct_relevel(timepoint, c("cCD PreTx", "cCD PostTx"))) %>% 
  ggplot(., aes(x = antitnf_response, y = meanVal)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "summary", fun = "mean",  color = "black", fill = "gray90") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - se, ymax = mean + se), color = "black", width=0.3, linewidth=1) +
  geom_line(aes(group = participant_id, color = antitnf_response), lwd = 1) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = antitnf_response), shape = 21, stroke = 2, color = "black",
             position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 1, seed = thisseed), alpha = 0.6, size = 4) +
  facet_grid(featureVar~timepoint, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = atnfColVec) +
  scale_color_manual(values = atnfColVec) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("cCD\nFR", "cCD\nPR")) +
  # stat_compare_means( comparisons = list(c("cCD\nPreTx", "cCD\nPostTx")),
  stat_compare_means( comparisons = list(c("FR","PR")), method = "wilcox.test",
    label = "p.format", vjust = 1.4, size = 5, tip.length = 0.05, bracket.size = 1) +
  labs(
    y = "Mean Gene Expression (Thelper Cells)",
    color = NULL,
    fill = NULL,
    title = NULL,
    shape = NULL,
    subtitle = NULL) +
  theme_light() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.spacing.x = unit(0.5, "cm"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "none",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", color = "black"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "black", linewidth = 1),
  )
```
